description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that serves as the launcher for an application demonstrating app restrictions. It manages fragment transactions, options menu behavior, and logging initialization.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android launcher activity that sets up the main view, initializes logging, manages menu options, and handles fragment transactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets content view, and adds the main fragment if activity is newly created.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu items visibility and title based on internal state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, notably toggling log view display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain with custom log nodes and attaches a log fragment for display.
